en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a rural landscape with fields in the foreground and a small village in the distance. A dirt road runs along the right side toward the village. There are scattered houses, trees, and what appears to be a church or mill with a tower. The lower part of the card is mostly blank with printed red Gothic-style text. A red number "131" is written or printed in the top right corner, and small vertical publisher text appears along the left margin.
